pr_title: Add `workspace: save without formatting` and default autosave without formatting
pr_body: - Added `autosave.after_delay/on_window_change/on_focus_change.trigger_formatter`closes #4882 One quirk to this implementation is you can have a configuration like this and the document won't format on save. A more accurate name for this setting is `trigger_format_on_save`. Open to changing it. - Added `workspace: save without formatting`. closes #5230 The default key binding is the same as vscode (`cmd-k s`), open to changing this as well.

issue_context.title: Decouple format_on_autosave from format_on_save
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

Currently when using `format_on_save` in combination with `autosave.after_delay` code jumps across constantly and it's not as pleasant as in VSCode (especially if you set it to smth like 500 ms).

### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature


Just a bool `format_on_autosave` (or `autosave.trigger_formatter`) flag in config which defaults to `false` to emulate how VSCode deals with it is more than enough

There is an issue (https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5230) to be able to cmd+s without triggering formatter, looks like resolving that could **massively** help with this one
comments: Totally agree. By default, code shouldn't format on auto-save.
Is it possible to enable auto-formatting on autosave now with the config only?

review_comments: Is it possible to get rid of this and handle the checks in here one layer up? It seems a bit weird to me that we have a trigger-to-format that includes "without formatting" :) Meaning: why have a noop trigger when we could instead not trigger?

Yeah, it is a bit strange. I included this because `SaveWithoutFormatting` will format whitespace. This is behavior I intentionally included because `format_on_save: false` formats whitespace on save.

It seems like we should change this behavior so `format_on_save: false` and save without formatting don't format whitespace. What do you think? If we do, we can easily replace this enum member by not calling `format` in `Item::save` like you suggested

> It seems like we should change this behavior so `format_on_save: false` and save without formatting don't format whitespace.

I think that makes sense. Another thought: maybe if we make the behavior more explicit (i.e. have something like `StripWhitespace` somewhere) things can become clearer in the code?
I'm wondering: can we get rid of that `unwrap_or(false)` here? I'm asking because I think ideally the default behavior is defined close to the type definition, not inside this code here.
makes sense, will update this
